mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% and is rising, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate and a rise in the federal funds rate indicates a weakening labor market coupled with monetary tightening, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
regime_hint: labor market stress during monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) in a late-cycle expansion regime indicate strong consumer demand, which accelerates corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with HOUST above 1200.0, or the Rank IC for the HOUST signal in late-cycle expansion is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates strengthening supply chain conditions and higher corporate output, which boosts earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1200.0 units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high CPIAUCSL index level regime (CPIAUCSL > 240.0), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 240.0 and FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC for the FEDFUNDS signal in high CPIAUCSL index level regimes is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
